description: This file defines React components and context setup for providing and consuming a LinkingController within a React application. It manages context creation, hooks for accessing the controller, and a provider component that supplies the controller to its children. It also wraps the provider with an observer to enable MobX reactivity.

methods.name: useLinkingController
methods.description: Custom hook to access the LinkingController from React context, throws error if used outside of its provider.

methods.name: LinkingControllerProvider
methods.description: Component that provides the LinkingController via React context to its children, wrapped with MobX observer for reactive updates.
